Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I have a family of 4 wanted a grill that has high output (BTUs), durable, and top quality production. Naturally Weber was at the top of the list. I researched several grills, and spoke with some friends who own gas grills. The Weber line of grills was the obvious choice. I was trying to decide if I should go for the top of the line Genesis or if a Spirit II would fit my needs more closely. A friend of mine who also has a family of four bought his E310 a year ago and couldn't say enough great things about it. I decided to go with the 3 burner vs the 2 burner so I could really get the temp up for great steaks. So far I've had the grill for about a month and used it about 15 times. The material it is built with is what you would expect from Weber. It has the BTUs to get as hot as a home cook could possibly need (0 to 600 in minutes). The cooking surface is plenty big for our family and still has plenty room for when we are entertaining guests. The grill looks great and has features that make it really easy to clean and maintain. If you take care of this grill it will be the last one you need to buy for decades. Many shy away from Weber because they can get "the same size grill" for cheaper, but i can promise you get what you pay for with the Weber Spirit II E310. I am so happy I made this purchase!
Results.Title: Weber Spirit II E310 (3 Burner Gas Grill)

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
If you’re like me, I read reviews, watch review videos...a lot of them, whenever I’m making a big ticket purchase. After all, I’m trying to find a grill that will last me many grilling seasons, with a great warranty to back it up. 

So, my review adventure began and I shopped the local “blue” store and the local “orange” store. I saw the many levels of brands on display, both much more and slightly less expensive than this grill. I saw the dents, the dings, the rusted grills, the ones waaaay out of my price range...then, I saw this Weber. It was basic, but nice. It was aluminum, not steel. It was mid-priced, but not too expensive or too cheap.

Now, I’m in my late 40’s and I’ve been using charcoal for well over 30 years. I stepped outside of my comfort zone for a change and this Weber seemed to fit the bill. All the reviews spoke about good heat retention, long lasting, great warranty, quick heating (even for only being 3 burners) and no huge gaping slit on the back where the lid closes (see good heat retention). I mentioned the “basic” look, but I like it. Large wheels to help clear obstacles when moving it, unlike casters that get stuck on a piece of gravel. I like the open front since all the doors would hide is the propane tank and spider webs. The fold down tray is great for the small area in my garage for storage. Basic, but practical. 

So, a stop by the local big box “blue” store and I picked up my grill, a propane tank and home I went. I noted that unlike many competitors reviews, the Weber box was intact, not damaged and that relayed over to the interior as well. Not a single mark on my new grill, let alone huge dents and dings like so many reviews about other grills. 

After setup (which took at about an hour), I had the tank attached and ready to go.  I will also note that Weber has the build down to a science. The wires for the grill igniter don’t need additional cable ties as they are the perfect length and sit in a series of clips. There were no missing screws or profanity used during my entire build.  

I’ve only used the grill twice since my purchase, just three days ago, but both times I can attest to the quick heating and amazing heat retention of the unit. The grill lights immediately and reliably. The heat is even across the entire grilling area. The size is just right for my family of four and I see this lasting me a long long time. 

So, stop looking around and pick this unit up. It’s so versatile and well built, you’ll be glad you did.
Results.Title: Stop shopping around and buy this grill!
